fieldValues.title: For every pair of stages A and B within a Protocol where B.dependsOn…
fieldValues.normative_statement: For every pair of stages A and B within a `Protocol` where B.dependsOn includes A.stageId, B.order must be greater than A.order. `order` is the declared composition order of the stages — structure, not presentation; it provides the render default. Execution sequence is determined by `dependsOn` resolution. The two must not contradict each other.
